supporting_observations.claim: Between 13:41 and 14:06 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 repeatedly connected to the internal proxy at roughly five-minute intervals; the available Zeek records show traffic to proxy port 8080 but do not identify the external HTTPS destinations or originating process.

Immediately after the stated telemetry-outage window, a proxy record shows a connection to update.chartmate-imaging.com, and endpoint records attribute the corresponding proxy connection to ChartMate's cmupdate.exe.

The observed five-minute cadence is consistent with the inventory's stated ChartMate updater schedule, making the updater a plausible explanation for the earlier proxy connections, but the available records do not establish that it generated them.

Before the alert window, Kerberos records show the account lucy.park requesting a service ticket for WS-LPARK-01 from WS-BCARTER-01's IP, followed by a network logon for lucy.park on WS-LPARK-01 originating from WS-BCARTER-01. The records establish the account use but not whether it was authorized.
At 13:58 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 established an SMB connection to DC-HD-01, and the DC recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon; the available records do not show what resource or operation was involved.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-status information reports a log-collection outage from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC for WS-BCARTER-01 winsec and Sysmon, and for the proxy sensor. This covers the core alert interval.

Zeek connection records remain available during the interval, but the provided records show connections to the internal proxy rather than the external HTTPS hostnames or the endpoint processes responsible.

The first directly attributable ChartMate proxy connection in the supplied records occurs at 14:10:59 UTC, after the stated outage window; it cannot by itself identify the processes responsible for earlier connections.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic proxy connections during the outage were all to update.chartmate-imaging.com or were generated by cmupdate.exe.

additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations and any available TLS inspection details, and correlate them with the periodic Zeek connections.
Recover endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 during the outage to attribute the connections to a process and user.
Validate with the relevant users or IT whether lucy.park's account use from WS-BCARTER-01 and the SMB connection to DC-HD-01 were expected.
Review DC-HD-01 and WS-LPARK-01 authentication and resource-access records around 13:20 UTC, plus DC-HD-01 SMB/resource-access records around 13:58 UTC.
